locator.title: Брать ипотеку в II половине 2026 года? Отвечают эксперты
locator.lead: Кому лучше купить недвижимость сейчас, а кому есть смысл подождать
locator.caption: Чаще всего ипотеку оформляют в Москве и Московской области. В феврале 2026 года спрос на том же уровне, что и в том же месяце прошлого года

nearest_text_before.text: Что касается 2026 года, в феврале средневзвешенная ставка по ипотеке составила 10% — это ещё ниже, чем в 2025 году. Тем не менее, цены на недвижимость продолжат расти. Именно поэтому тем, кто хочет приобрести собственную квартиру, стоит купить недвижимость в ближайшее время.

image_reading: A horizontal three-series bar chart compares mortgage issuance volumes across ten Russian regions.
Blue February 2026 bars, dark-gray January 2026 bars, and light-gray February 2025 bars are shown with fixed labels, values, axes, gridlines, and legend.
The largest blue bar is Moscow at 34.5, followed by Moscow Oblast at 20.4; all chart content is static UI.
analysis.article_context: Body chart following the discussion of lower mortgage rates; it compares regional mortgage issuance and supports the point that Moscow and the Moscow region lead, with February 2026 demand roughly matching February 2025.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Emphasize the leading role of Moscow in February 2026 mortgage issuance while retaining the chart's factual comparison.
structured_intent.primary_action: A soft optical highlight travels across the existing February 2026 Moscow bar.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The highlight has reached and faded at the right end of the Moscow February 2026 bar, with the chart otherwise unchanged.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The chart remains an unchanged factual comparison of regional mortgage issuance.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, keep the chart completely fixed. A restrained optical highlight begins near the left of the existing blue Moscow bar, travels evenly along it, then fades near its right end so the final frame shows the unchanged chart with only a faint residual sheen.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed chart. A soft blue highlight glides slowly along the February 2026 Moscow bar and fades by the last frames; all labels, values, bars, axes, and layout remain unchanged.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, use a single soft sheen on the existing blue Moscow bar. It progresses smoothly from left to right for most of the duration and settles as a barely visible highlight at the bar's endpoint near the finish; no chart elements change.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed chart with a subtle blue sheen moving across the February 2026 Moscow bar, then settling into a faint highlight at its right end; chart data and layout remain unchanged.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds with a fixed camera, make one subtle glint travel across the already visible blue Moscow bar at a steady pace. It reaches the right end close to the final moment and fades, leaving the chart's information and layout exactly as shown.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. A gentle blue glint sweeps across the February 2026 Moscow bar and fades at the right endpoint by the final frame, while every chart value and element stays unchanged.
